astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Shapley 1: An Annular Planetary Nebula
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: What’s looking back at you isn’t a cosmic eye, but Shapley 1, a beautifully symmetric planetary nebula.  Shapley 1, also known as the Fine Ring Nebula or PLN 329+2.1, bejewels the southern sky constellation of the Carpenter's Square  (Norma).
